source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, International Energy Statistics FAQ
reuse: Public-domain EIA information; attribution with publication date. No logos or third-party illustrations reused.
accounting: Primary energy consumption, using the EIA table's own definitions. Non-renewable is total minus renewable and includes nuclear; it is not fossil-only.
model: Original VENTUS uniform-rate illustration: annual MWh divided by days in reference year, multiplied by fraction of current UTC day. No claim of measured current-year demand.
